API_KEY_IN_URL: Send the API key in the Authorization header, not in the address.
API_KEY_REQUIRED: Create an API key or add a person before allowing access from other devices.
BENCHMARK_UNSUPPORTED: Benchmarks aren't available on this computer.
COMPUTER_OFFLINE: The computer running this model is offline.
CONNECTION_LOST: The connection to the model was lost.
CONTEXT_TOO_LONG: This chat is too long for the model.
EXTERNAL_BAD_URL: The base URL must start with http:// or https://, such as https://api.openai.com/v1.
EXTERNAL_LOCAL_ONLY: This chat uses memories or knowledge marked This computer only, so it can't go to the external server. Choose a model on this computer.
EXTERNAL_OFFLINE_PROFILE: This profile keeps work on this computer, so it doesn't use the external server. Choose a model on this computer or another profile.
HARDWARE_DETECT_FAILED: Toskar couldn't fully detect this computer's hardware. Some details may be missing.
HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: This address is not one of this computer's. Open Toskar at http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost, or send an API key.
INVALID_LOCALE: That isn't a language Toskar recognizes.
INVALID_RATING: A rating is 1 to 5 stars, with reasons from the list.
JOIN_NOT_REACHABLE: Other computers can't reach this one. Turn on Find other computers, then restart Toskar.
JOIN_OTHER_NETWORK: This computer is already in another Toskar network. Run toskarctl leave first to join this one.
JOIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many join attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and try again.
JOIN_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This join token has expired. Make a new join command on a computer in the network.
JOIN_TOKEN_INVALID: This join token isn't valid. Make a new join command on a computer in the network.
JOIN_TOKEN_NOT_ACTIVE: That join token can't be revoked: it was already used, revoked, or expired.
JOIN_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND: No join token has that ID.
JOIN_TOKEN_REVOKED: This join token was revoked. Make a new join command on a computer in the network.
JOIN_TOKEN_USED: This join token has already been used. Make a new join command for each computer.
JOIN_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach Toskar at {{server}}. Check the address, the firewall, and that Toskar is running there.
JOIN_WRONG_SERVER: The computer at that address isn't the one the join command was made on. Nothing that proves the token was sent.
LOG_NOT_FOUND: That log file couldn't be opened.
MCP_NOT_FOUND: There's no tool source with that name.
MEMORY_LOOKS_SECRET: That looks like a password, key, or token, so Toskar didn't save it.
GPU_SETUP_FAILED: Couldn't check this computer's GPU setup.
LIVE_FIGURES_FAILED: Couldn't read this computer's CPU, memory, and GPU figures.
MODEL_FILE_INVALID: This isn't a model Toskar can use: {{detail}}.
MODEL_FILE_PROJECTOR: This is a vision projector, which helps a model see pictures. Add the model it belongs to.
NEEDS_APPROVAL: This needs your approval before the automation can go on.
NO_MODEL_ASSIGNED: No model is chosen for this. Install one in Models, or choose one in the profile.
NO_MODEL_INSTALLED: No model is installed yet. Install one in Models to start chatting.
NO_TEXT_FOUND: No text found. Scanned PDFs need text recognition (OCR) before Toskar can read them.
ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Websites cannot use Toskar without an API key.
OUT_OF_MEMORY: The model ran out of memory.
PAIRING_RATE_LIMITED: Too many pairing attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and start pairing again.
PEER_TOO_OLD: That computer needs a newer Toskar to run tools for others.
PREFERENCE_CANNOT_GRANT_TOOLS: Preferences and memories can't give permission to use tools. Change what tools may do in Settings → Tool permissions or in a profile.
RATINGS_UNREACHABLE: Your rating is saved on this computer, but the ratings service couldn't be reached. Try again later.
RATING_NOT_SHAREABLE: This model can't be compared with others' ratings, so its rating stays on this computer.
RUNTIME_ERROR: The model's engine ran into an error.
RUNTIME_NOT_INSTALLED: {{runtime}} isn't installed. Install it in Models.
RUN_NOT_FOUND: That run isn't recorded, or its record was removed.
SANDBOXED: This copy of Toskar runs in the macOS App Sandbox, which can't run a Python environment it downloads.
SERVICE_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach the local Toskar service ({{detail}}). If this is the desktop app, quit and reopen it so the service restarts.
SPEECH_SETUP_FAILED: Read aloud couldn't be set up on this computer. Diagnostics shows what's missing.
SPEECH_NO_VOICE: There is no voice to read {{language}} aloud yet.
SUPPORT_MODEL_BUSY: The supporting model can't run right now.
TOOL_SOURCE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: That gallery entry or app setting wasn't found.
UNAUTHORIZED: This Toskar needs an API key.
UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Toskar can't read {{name}} yet. Attach a document, spreadsheet, PDF, code file, audio, video, or a PNG or JPEG image.
DEVICE_NOT_ALLOWED: A device's key can't do this. Use a key from API Access.
PORTAL_NOT_FOUND: There's no portal at this address, or it's turned off.
PORTAL_TOO_LONG: A message here can be {{max}} characters at most.
PORTAL_BUSY: This chat is busy. Try again in a moment.
PORTAL_RATE: You've sent a lot of messages. Try again later.
PROFILE_PINNED: This key answers only with its own profile. Leave out the profile and model, or name that profile.
PIN_INVALID: That pin can't be saved. Only Members and Visitors are pinned, and only to profiles that exist.
PINS_FAILED: Couldn't read which profiles people are pinned to.
TRIAL_FAILED: Couldn't try that message. Check the topic controls and that a model is ready.
EXAMPLES_FULL: The profile has 20 example questions. Remove one to add this.
MARK_FAILED: Couldn't mark that as on topic.
PORTAL_MEMBERS: This chat is for the people who sign in to this Toskar.
PORTAL_INVITE: This chat is by invitation. Open the link you were sent, or ask for a new one.
PORTAL_INVALID: That portal setting can't be used.
PORTAL_ONLY: A portal's visitor can only chat in the portal.
PROXY_REFUSED: Your sign-in doesn't give you a role on this Toskar. Ask its Owner to add you to a group that does.
DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: No device of yours has that id.
DEVICES_FAILED: Couldn't read or change your devices.
PAIRING_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Choose Connect a device on the computer again.
PAIRING_NOT_LOCAL: A device can connect only from the computer's own network.
PAIRING_NOT_STARTED: That computer isn't showing a code. Choose Connect a device on it first.
PAIRING_THROTTLED: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
PAIRING_WRONG_CODE: That isn't the code the computer shows. Check it and try again.
LAN_ACCESS_OFF: Local network access is off on this computer, so it only answers apps on it.
LAN_ACCESS_FAILED: Local network access couldn't be turned on.
AUTOMATION_RUNNING: This automation is already running. Its result will appear here when it finishes.
AUTOMATION_NO_RESULT: This run has no result to continue in chat.
AUTOMATION_TIMEOUT: The run took longer than {{minutes}} minutes and was stopped. Try a faster model or a shorter prompt.
REQUEST_NO_SCHEDULE: Describe when it should run, for example “every morning at 8:00 AM”.
AUTOMATION_NOT_WEBHOOK: This automation doesn't run from a webhook.
HOOK_TOO_SOON: This webhook was called a moment ago. Try again in a few seconds.
HOOK_TOO_LARGE: The request body is larger than 64 KB.
SIGN_IN_FAILED: That username and password don't match.
SIGN_IN_THROTTLED: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
INVITE_INVALID: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
USERNAME_INVALID: A username is 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores.
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: A password needs at least 10 characters.
OWNER_FIXED: The Owner's role can't change, and nobody changes their own role or disables themselves.
CROSS_SITE: That change didn't come from Toskar's own pages, so it was refused.
MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND: That message isn't in this chat anymore. Reload the chat and try again.
INVALID_BRANCH: Send one of parent_id, retry_of, or edit_of, with the chat's conversation_id.
REMOTE_THROTTLED: Too many wrong keys came from this address. Try again later.
REMOTE_DEVICES_ONLY: From outside the home network, only paired devices can connect.
REMOTE_PORT_INVALID: The port is 1024 to 65535, and not the one the app or the computers use.
REMOTE_ADDRESS_INVALID: Enter a host name or IP, with a port when it differs, such as home.example.com or 203.0.113.7:7333.
REMOTE_LISTEN_FAILED: Access from anywhere can't listen on port {{port}}. Another program may be using it.
RELAY_INVALID: Enter the relay's name, such as relay.example.com, with a port only when it isn't 443.
RELAY_SECRET_INVALID: That isn't an enrollment secret. Copy it from the relay's enroll.secret file.
RELAY_TOKEN_INVALID: That relay token isn't for this computer, or it has run out. Subscribe again from this device.
RELAY_TOKEN_NOT_NEEDED: This computer uses your organization's relay, so it doesn't need a subscription.
RELAY_TOKEN_FAILED: Couldn't save the relay token on this computer.
ROUTE_NOT_LOCAL: Connect at home once to set up access from anywhere on this device.
ROUTE_FAILED: Couldn't set up access from anywhere on this computer.
